verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair privacy question for a GPU cloud platform, since its console, preinstalled software stack, and instance images could collect usage data. Nothing in the pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The 'Usage page' references describe billing usage views, not a tracking control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
